properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 9 at 12:40PM AKST until November 9 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Annette Island, Ketchikan Gateway Borough, and Western
Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong wind gusts will continue through the
early afternoon before gradually diminishing through Monday
evening.
properties.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
